fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (45.40239,-91.847592, ROOFTOP) landed directly on the plant. Confirmed Jennie-O via the green Jennie-O logo on the 3-story office building (StreetView 2024) and the 34 N 7th St address. Locked center 45.40240,-91.84680 on the main turkey-processing complex in Barron, WI.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open truck entrance. StreetView (2024) shows the main truck driveway off the public road running uncontrolled into the plant yard -- no barrier arm and no gate across the truck drive. A green privacy-slat chain-link fence encloses the office/employee area and part of the south yard, but the truck entry itself is open. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the open truck entrance.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs straight through the complex with spurs serving buildings and the grain/feed silos -> railServed true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building turkey campus (processing buildings, separate warehouse/DC, feed mill with silos, support buildings) -> multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on separate building faces (N and S), consistent with separate raw-receive vs finished-ship operations at a slaughter+processing plant -> shipRcvSeparate true.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple trailer drop areas -- a large NE trailer yard and a S-side yard -- with 45+ trailers parked -> dropYard true; dropArea 25-50.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~40 dock doors estimated across the multiple building faces; banded 25-50, low-confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open truck entrance and large paved yard leave ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Barron WI is a small rural city (~3,400); the plant is at the edge of town surrounded by small-town residential and farmland -> Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is plausible at a turkey slaughter plant but was not positively identified in imagery -> classified false, flagged.
